name: Close Ranks
description:
While you and at least one ally are adjacent to one another, you and all adjacent allies gain +5 Defense.

Once per round, you may spend a half action or 1 MP to give an adjacent ally +1d on their next attack roll.

Describe how you form up.

improvements.name: Shield Wall
improvements.description: While you and at least one ally are adjacent to one another and each of you is wielding a shield, you and each adjacent ally automatically win engagement.

improvements.name: Hold The Line
improvements.description: While you and at least one ally are adjacent to one another, you and all adjacent allies may contribute engagement dice to each other's engagement rolls.
